title: ALMA Observations toward the Starburst Dwarf Galaxy NGC 5253. I. Molecular Cloud Properties and Scaling Relations
question: What are the properties of parsec-scale molecular clouds in the starburst dwarf galaxy NGC 5253, how do they compare with scaling relations, and what is the origin of the starburst?

data.arrays: 12 m, ACA 7 m and Total Power

what.value: Star cluster catalogs (ages, masses) for cloud association

evidence.quote: We also used the catalog in (cite: 2013MNRAS.431.2917D) to cover other star clusters.

what.value: CO(1-0) integrated intensity 1.3 K km/s, width 43 km/s

evidence.quote: reported a CO(1–0) integrated intensity of 1.3 K $\mbox{km s$^{-1}$}$ with a velocity width of 43 km s$^{-1}$
Using the correlation between gas-to-dust mass ratio (GTD) and metallicity in (cite: 2014A&A...563A..31R)

what.value: Gas density and temperature for N5253-D and C

evidence.quote: using the molecular gas density and kinetic temperature for N5253-D and N5253-C in (cite: 2015Natur.519..331T)

recipe.method: Manual CASA calibration of 12m/7m, pipeline TP, clean with Briggs weighting, then feather with TP
CPROPS with 5 sigma masking, extrapolation to zero intensity, beam and channel deconvolution; bootstrap uncertainties
assumptions: Spherical virialized clouds with rho ∝ r^-1; Mvir = 189 dV^2 R

recipe.goal: Derive XCO from virial mass vs CO luminosity
recipe.method: Fit log-log relation with slope fixed to unity; Mgas = 4.3 (XCO/2) L'CO(2-1)/R21
assumptions: R2-1/1-0 = 1 (measured 0.96 from TP vs SEST); factor 1.36 for helium; D=3.15 Mpc

recipe.goal: Scaling relations, surface density and pressure
recipe.method: Compare line-width-size, Mgas-R and sigma^2/R vs Sigma with literature CPROPS samples

recipe.goal: Cross-match clouds with star clusters and compute SFE and forces
recipe.method: Positional overlap at 3 sigma extent after astrometry correction; SFE = M*/(Mgas+M*); Frad = L/c; Fgrav = G Mgas^2/R^2

recipe.goal: PVDs, disk-rotation model and gas inflow rates
recipe.method: PV cuts at several PAs, compared to a disk model with Vrot ~30 km/s; inflow rate = 1.0e-6 Mgas Vgrad/tan i

evidence.quote: we have identified a total of 118 molecular clouds
with average values of 2.2 km s$^{-1}$  and 4.3 pc

We then obtain $R_{2-1/1-0}$ of 0.96 with an uncertainty of $\sim20$ %

The SFEs we obtain for NGC 5253 range from 5 % to 64 %.

we found that six clouds appear spatially associated with 10 star clusters
